hero.title: Care You Can Trust for Your
hero.description: Sanad connects families with verified, compassionate caregivers. From medical assistance to daily companionship, find the perfect support today.
hero.quoteText: Sanad helped us find Sarah, who has been a blessing for my mother.

how.title: How Sanad Works
how.subtitle: Getting dignified care is simple and secure. Follow these three steps to get started.
how.step1Text: Browse detailed profiles of caregivers in your area. Filter by specialty, experience, and ratings.
how.step2Text: Schedule an introductory meeting or book care directly through our secure booking system.
how.step3Text: Receive professional support in the comfort of home. Payment and tracking are handled in-app.

why.title: Why Choose Sanad?
why.subtitle: We are building the world's most trusted community for home care.
why.verifiedText: Every caregiver undergoes rigorous ID and background checks.
why.chatText: Communicate safely through our encrypted messaging system.
why.bookingText: Seamlessly manage appointments and shifts with one tap.
why.communityText: A feedback-driven network ensuring the highest standards.

testimonials.title: Trusted by Families Everywhere
testimonials.one: Finding a post-op nurse through Sanad was incredibly easy. The quality of care was exceptional.
testimonials.two: As a professional nurse, Sanad gives me the flexibility I need while allowing me to connect with wonderful families.
testimonials.three: The verification process gave us the confidence we needed to bring someone into our home.
